moments.text: Handheld night recording of a dark, grainy sky. A tiny faint light point wanders around the frame as the camera pans.
The light point is out of view; only dim, brownish grain shows.
A tiny light point returns from the lower edge and is followed near the centre, showing as a distinct pale dot around 35 s.
The light point comes and goes: brief glimpses at 47–49 s and 53–57 s between empty grainy stretches.
The picture turns darker; one or two small red lights move around the frame, sometimes a close pair with a single one lower left.
The view zooms in: the picture turns coarse and the red lights grow into short double dashes, smeared by camera shake.
Zoomed in, a pair of lights shakes around the frame, turning from red to white-yellow; a single light sometimes shows below it.
